g.title: HR_SHORTLISTEDCND
g.text: Shortlisted Candidates - Shortlisted candidates are those candidates, internal or external, to whom a Job offer for a specific Vacancy has been proposed. For each candidate, basic contractual and deployment terms and conditions are also specified.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The name used to identify a Job Vacancy.
The identifier of the Applicant record.
The Identifier of the Job record.
The identifier of the Worker Type record.
The Identifier of the Contract Type record.
The Identifier of the Contract Level record.
A list of Job classifications, defining and evaluating the duties, responsibilities, tasks, and authority level of a job.
The Identifier of the Location record.
Date the Job Offer has been accepted by the Candidate.
The date on which the associated person was hired. Some contexts and situations may require fine-grain distinctions. See Original Hire Date, Duty Entry Date.
The number of months the contract is exepected to last.
The number of months for the probation period.
The minimum number of days the Candidate will have to notify the Company in case of an anticipated contract resume.
The Identifier of the Working Time Pattern record.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
The Identifier of the Reject Reason record.
Identifier of a Candidate Record, used to keep HCM in synch with Core HR.
Is the identifier of the candidate's list agency.
The identifier of the recruitment request record.
